mc-leper-touch.title: Moved with compassion
mc-leper-touch.alt: Jesus rests His hand on the shoulder of a kneeling man, and they look into each other’s eyes.
mc-leper-touch.caption: The man kneels before Jesus and asks to be made clean. Moved with compassion, the Savior reaches out and touches him.
mc-leper-touch.status: planned; generation and visual review required
